definition: a dessert of sponge fingers filled with cream
description: Inside an old wood-panelled train dining car with snowy pink mountains outside the windows, a young chef in a white jacket and grey neckerchief lifts a tall shiny metal ring off a round dessert on a white tablecloth: a cake walled with upright sponge fingers, topped with cream and raspberries and tied with a pink ribbon. A woman in a velvet top covers her mouth in surprise, a man in a dinner jacket stares and then smiles, and other diners watch from lamp-lit tables.
